tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Upload an image to BasePic and get links: page_url (short link to share), image_url (direct image) and download_url. Give either a public "url" (an image, or a post on X/Instagram/Facebook) or "image_base64". Returns an id for edit_image and a delete_key. Images up to 50 MB. The image is private: only people with the link can see it. A file on your disk: a path or file:// link does not work as url — if you can run commands, upload it with curl -F "image=@photo.jpg" https://basepic.com/api/v1/images instead (same JSON answer; its id works with edit_image).

url.description: Public https link to the image

image_base64.description: The image as base64 (a data: URL works too)

return_preview.description: Also return a small preview of the image so you can look at it (default false)

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Edit an uploaded image: rotate, flip, crop (pixels or aspect ratio), resize (width/height, percent, megapixels), grayscale (black & white), sepia, brightness, contrast, warm, cool, invert, blur, sharpen — applied in order. Optionally change the format (jpeg/png/webp) or make the file at most max_kb kilobytes (1 KB = 1,000 bytes). Creates a NEW image with its own page_url, image_url and download_url; the original stays unchanged.

id.description: Image id returned by upload_image or edit_image (e.g. "vqSvesFU")

aspect.description: crop: centered crop to a ratio like "1:1", "4:5", "16:9"

width.description: crop width, or resize target width (keeps proportions)

height.description: crop height, or resize target height (keeps proportions)

format.description: Output format: jpeg, png or webp. If omitted, the new image keeps the original format (a GIF becomes png). jpeg has no transparency: transparent areas turn white.

quality.description: JPEG/WebP quality, 1–100 (default 90). png ignores it (lossless). With max_kb, the highest quality tried.

max_kb.description: Largest file size in KB, 1 KB = 1,000 bytes (jpeg/webp)

filename.description: Optional file name for the new image, e.g. "beach-small.jpg". Its extension is set to match the output format. If omitted: the original name + "-edited".

return_preview.description: Also return a small preview of the image so you can look at it (default false)

tools.name: get_image
tools.description: Get the links and details (size, dimensions, type) of an image on BasePic by its id.

id.description: Image id returned by upload_image or edit_image (e.g. "vqSvesFU")

return_preview.description: Also return a small preview of the image so you can look at it (default false)

tools.name: delete_image
tools.description: Delete an image from BasePic. Needs the delete_key returned when it was uploaded or created by edit_image. Its links stop working.

id.description: Image id returned by upload_image or edit_image (e.g. "vqSvesFU")

delete_key.description: The delete_key returned for this image by upload_image, edit_image or POST /api/v1/images
